reviews.comment: Do not take if possible. I did not learn a single thing. You have 3 papers, a final paper, and a presentation. The paper instructions are very confusing and she is a very tough grader. One of the worst classes I have ever taken.

If you like history then you will enjoy this class. Her lectures are very informative. Her feedback is not very good, I asked for suggestions to improve and all she did was leave three sentences of notes just mentioning the negatives. Overall not a terrible class, just boring, and the professor is pretty rude.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very passionate about what she teaches. She is not a bad professor. You will read alot! 3 papers in total plus a final paper at the end. She seems to grade pretty hard but she does give good feedback to make you a better writer. I personally wouldnt take her class again, just wasnt my style of learning i guess but i see why people like her.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: worst professor ive had and grades very harshly, didnt even learn a single thing.
Professor Jackson knows her stuff, however she grades pretty harshly.

Dr. Jackson knows her stuff but seems to have a hard time making it accessible. She isn't great at fostering discussion, but her lectures are pretty good. If you need to take her, she is definitely not the worst prof I've had. I just ended up teaching myself a lot of the content.

Dr. Jackson is an amazing Professor! As long as you are willing to do the work and care about the material you will do well! If you communicate with her, she will help you succeed! She is very smart and knowledgeable about what she teaches and it shows! Go to office hours if you can! Also she sometimes brings her dog and its awesome!!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: I enjoyed everyday in that class, and the conversations I had with this professor. The professor makes you work for your grade but the material chosen for this course was fun to read/study. As long as you actually study the reading assignments and watch the films like you're supposed to you're good to go. The professor made lectures fun!
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Takes a long time to grade your stuff. Strangely, she never seems to be prepared for class. She sits (not stands, sits) in front of the class and reads to you directly from her notes. Sometimes she realizes she left her tea in another part of the building and leaves class to go retrieve it. When asked a question she seems befuddled and then laughs
